description: This file configures engine parameters for a Mazda Miata NB1 vehicle. It sets various engine modes, thermistor configurations, ADC channels, GPIO pins for actuators, and other hardware-specific settings.

methods.name: void setMazdaMiataNb1EngineConfiguration(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Initializes and sets the engine configuration parameters specific to Mazda Miata NB1, including trigger type, injection modes, thermistor settings, ADC channels, GPIO pin assignments, and other hardware controls.
